label: Applicability registry for consult-compliance-engagement. Editions are as known on 2026-11-25 from the rig's reference knowledge and were not re-fetched; confirm the current edition at the publisher before an engagement relies on it. Ids match compliance-os framework_selector.py output where that script covers the framework.

wcag_2_2.name: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.2
wcag_2_2.rights_note: W3C Document License; cite, do not copy
wcag_2_2.attestation: none: no body certifies WCAG conformance; a conformance claim is the content owner's, scoped to pages and a level

pci_dss.name: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard
pci_dss.rights_note: Download requires accepting the PCI SSC license agreement; do not redistribute
pci_dss.attestation: Report on Compliance by a Qualified Security Assessor, or a Self-Assessment Questionnaire as the acquirer requires

iso_27001.name: ISO/IEC 27001 information security management systems
iso_27001.rights_note: Copyrighted; buy a licensed copy before using its text or Annex A wording
iso_27001.attestation: Certificate from an accredited certification body

soc_2.name: SOC 2, AICPA Trust Services Criteria
soc_2.edition: 2017 Trust Services Criteria (revised points of focus, 2022)
soc_2.rights_note: AICPA copyright; free download, cite rather than copy
soc_2.attestation: SOC 2 report issued by a licensed CPA firm

nist_csf_2.name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework
nist_csf_2.attestation: none: no certification exists; organizations describe their own profile

nist_sp_800_53.name: NIST SP 800-53 Security and Privacy Controls
nist_sp_800_53.edition: Revision 5 (confirm the current minor release at use)
nist_sp_800_53.attestation: Depends on the program that requires it (for example a federal authorization); none by itself

gdpr.name: General Data Protection Regulation
gdpr.attestation: none for the regulation itself; a legal conclusion on compliance belongs to counsel or a supervisory authority
